title: Residents protest custody death of detained man in Malkangiri

tea.why: Residents and family protested after a detained man was found dead in a Malkangiri hotel room following his detention by Haryana police.
tea.want: Protesters demanded an impartial investigation, stringent action, and the arrest of the visiting Haryana police personnel involved.
tea.changed: Oct 27: Protesters blocked National Highway 326, burned tyres, and surrounded the Malkangiri police station.

summary: Tension gripped Malkangiri town in Odisha after a young man detained by a visiting police team from Haryana in connection with a narcotics case was found dead in a hotel room. Family members and local residents gathered outside the Malkangiri police station, burned tyres, and blocked National Highway 326 to protest the death. The family alleged that the visiting officers assaulted and killed the man before attempting to pass the incident off as a suicide. Protesters questioned why the detained man was held in a private lodge rather than a local police station. Malkangiri Superintendent of Police Vinod Patil stated that an unnatural death case was registered, the body was sent for post-mortem, and an investigation into the cause of death is currently underway.
demands: Conduct an impartial investigation into the death
Arrest the Haryana police personnel involved
Take stringent action against those responsible
response: Malkangiri Superintendent of Police Vinod Patil stated that an unnatural death case has been registered and an investigation is underway. He noted that the body was recovered, sent for post-mortem, and further action will follow the investigation findings, according to sources.

deaths.text: A man detained in a narcotics case died in Haryana Police's custody

updates.text: Tension gripped Malkangiri after a detained youth was found hanging in a hotel room.
Protesters blocked National Highway 326, burned tyres, and surrounded the police station.
